newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel prices firm but still fragile.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel prices firm but still fragile.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil prices firmed on Thursday as demand picked up slightly in line with benchmark IPE gas oil futures gains, traders said.
July IPE gas oil futures settled 75 cents higher at $159.50 a tonne having closed $5 lower on Wednesday.
Barge premiums were little changed at around July IPE +$15.00/+$16.00 fob ARA.
Traders said abundant stocks and slack demand continued to make for a lacklustre market.
